character: The original 'Alpine chic' resort. Founded 1910s by Rothschild family. Elegant mountain town with cobbled streets, stone buildings, chapel. Flocons de Sel (3 Michelin stars—Emmanuel Renait). Palais Megève ice rink. High-end boutiques. 100+ restaurants. Ski on Mont d'Arbois, Jaillet, Rochebrune.
dining: Flocons de Sel (3*). Le 1920. La Taverne du Mont Blanc. Les Enfants Terribles. Ferme de Cupallion. 100+ restaurants.
shopping: Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Pucci. Art galleries. Snowleader ski shop. Weekly market. Fromageries. Supermarket.
apres_scene: Le 1920 (cocktails). La Folie Douce (Mont d'Arbois). Le Caprice des Neiges. Casino. Palais bars.
activities_nearby: Palais Megève (ice rink, pool, cinema, spa). Casino. 400km Evasion Mont Blanc. Golf (18-hole, Mont d'Arbois). Paragliding, dog sledding. Quadrat spa.
